'''Trinity''' (Japanese: '''タカミ''' ''Takami'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|GS}} episode ''[[EP217|The Perfect Match!]]''. She was one of the competitors in the [[Whirl Cup]] and {{an|Misty}}'s rival in the tournament.

==History==
Like Misty, Trinity [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Water}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. Impressed with Misty's performance in the [[Whirl Cup]], they personally met after Misty's win against {{Ash}} in the competition in ''[[EP217|The Perfect Match!]]''. {{an|Brock}} remembered her from her previous victory, mentioning that she fought perfectly. Trinity battled Misty in the third round against her {{TP|Misty|Poliwhirl}} and {{TP|Misty|Corsola}}, and won after a tough battle. At the end of the battle, Misty and Trinity met up again. Misty congratulated her for the victory and wished good luck to her rival and friend in her next battle, which ultimately lead her to the finals of the competition.

Just before the match began between her and [[Whirl Cup winner|a powerful Trainer]] with a {{p|Feraligatr}}, she, Misty, Ash, and the Trainer united to defeat {{TRT}}, who was trying to steal the [[Sea Spirit|Great Sea Spirit Sapphire]] from the hands of {{jo|Maya}}. After that, her finals battle continued, but she eventually lost the battle. As a result, she was ranked second in the tournament. At the end of the episode, she appeared next to Ash, Misty, and Brock, talking about how they could improve their skills with Water-type Pokémon.

She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[EP226|Espeon, Not Included]]''.
